main_text.l: מִישָׁרִים m.p. Rectitudines, Recta : עֵינֶיךָ תְּחֻזֶינָה מִישָׁרִים Oculi tui videbunt recta, Psal.17.2. מִישָׁרִים אֲהֵבוּךָ Rectitudinibus diligunt te, Cant.1.v.4. id est, rectissimè, hoc est, Amore forti & vehementi, qui caret salebris & pravitatibus, ut R. Salomon explicat.

יָשֵׁשׁ m. Decrepitus: זָקֵן וְיָשֵׁשׁ Seni & decrepito, 2.Paral.36.17. Et cum Chirek, יָשִׁישׁ Idem : גַּם שָׂב גַּם יָשִׁישׁ Et canus & decrepitus, Job.15.v.10. Plural. בִּישִׁישִׁים חָכְמָה In decrepitis est sapientia, Job.12.12.
יָת Chald. Articulus Accusativi casus, respondens Hebraeo אֶת : cum Pronom. יָתְהוֹן Eos, Dan.3.v.12. In Targum scribitur יָת cum Pathach.

יָתַב Chald. Sedit, Habitavit, ex Hebraeo יָשַׁב. Praet. וְעַתִּיק יוֹמִין יָתִיב Et antiquus dierum sedit, Dan.7.9. & יָתַב vers.10. Particip.Plur. דִּי יָתְבִין Qui habitabant, Esr.4.17. Aphel, וְהוֹתִיב [?] הָמוֹ Et habitare fecit eos, Esr.4.v.10.

יָתַד f. Paxillus, Palus, Clavus: Constr. אֶת־יְתַד הָאֹהֶל Paxillum tentorii, Jud.4.21. Plur. וְכָל־הַיְתֵדֹת Et omnes paxillos, Exod.38.20. Constr. יְתֵדֹת הֶחָצֵר Paxilli atrii, Exod.27.19. Aff. יְתֵדֹתָיו Paxilli ejus, Ibid.
יָתוֹם m. Pupillus, Deuter.10. v.18. Plural. יְתוֹמִים Exod.22.25. Aff. וְאֶת־יְתֹמָיו Et pupillos ejus, Jesa.19.v.17.

יָתַר Hiph. הוֹתִיר Reliquit, Reliquum, Residuum esse fecit; Abundavit, Abundantem, Excellentem effecit: Praeter. הוֹתִיר לָנוּ Reliquum fecisset nobis superstitem, Jesa.19. Hoph. Futur. אַל־תּוֹתַר Ne fias excellens, Genes.49.4. & Cholem est loco Schurek, scribit Aben Esra: Item Infinit. וְהוֹתֵר Et superesse, Remanendo, Exod.36.7. id est, Supererat. Niph. נוֹתַר Relinqui, Re-

page.notes: Printed page number "345" at top left. Running head is Hebrew letters ש י ת, copied as printed. Signature "r 5" at lower left is uncertain. Long s was normalised to plain s throughout, so "verf." became "vers." and "rectissimè" became "rectissimè". The Hebrew vocalisation of the entry at Esr.4.v.10 (וְהוֹתִיב הָמוֹ) is a best reading and is marked [?]. The reference "Jesa.19." in the יָתַר entry is hard to read and may be "Jesa.1.9.". The final word "Re-" is a hyphen at the page end, and the entry continues on the next page.
